cgv.title: Terms and conditions of sale
cgv.intro: These terms cover the bookings and rides provided by Navette Xpress in Senegal. By booking, you accept them.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: Navette Xpress is a chauffeur-driven passenger transport service based in Dakar (Senegal), registered under NINEA 012269115 and RCCM SN DKR 2014 A 5816.
Contact: contact@navettexpress.com, +221 78 465 13 02.

sections.heading: 2. Booking and quotes
paragraphs: A booking is confirmed once you receive our confirmation message (email or WhatsApp). The details you enter (locations, date, time, flight number, passengers, luggage) are your responsibility: please check them.
A quote is valid for 30 days. It becomes binding on both parties once accepted.

sections.heading: 3. Prices
paragraphs: Prices are in CFA francs. The price is fixed and announced before the ride; tolls and fuel are included. A surcharge may apply for a larger vehicle or a night ride: it is announced at booking.
Public prices by segment are shown on the Pricing page. If they differ, the price on your confirmation or quote prevails.

sections.heading: 4. Payment
paragraphs: Payment is made by Wave, Orange Money, bank transfer or cash, as set out on your quote or invoice.
An invoice is payable on receipt or by the due date it shows. Any objection must be reported to us within 7 days.

sections.heading: 5. Airport waiting time
paragraphs: For airport pick-ups, waiting is free if your flight is delayed, provided the flight number was given at booking.

sections.heading: 6. Changes and cancellation
paragraphs: You can change or cancel a booking by contacting us. The applicable cancellation conditions (notice period, any fees) are those shown on your quote or booking confirmation.
If we have to cancel or change a ride, we tell you as soon as possible and offer an equivalent solution or a refund of any amount already paid.

sections.heading: 7. Customer obligations
paragraphs: The customer arrives at the agreed place and time, keeps to the booked number of passengers and luggage, and behaves respectfully towards the driver and vehicle. The driver may refuse or stop a ride in case of danger or inappropriate behaviour.

sections.heading: 8. Liability
paragraphs: We take the necessary measures to provide a safe and punctual ride. We cannot be held liable for delays caused by external circumstances (traffic, weather, force majeure) or for items left or undeclared in the vehicle.

sections.heading: 9. Personal data
paragraphs: How we process your data is described in our privacy policy.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Senegalese law. In the event of a dispute we first seek an amicable solution; failing that, the courts of Dakar have jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect, why, and how you stay in control of it.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Navette Xpress, Dakar (Senegal). Contact: contact@navettexpress.com.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Booking, quote and contact: name, email, phone number, ride locations and times, flight number, passengers, free-text message.
Account: email, password (stored encrypted), role, email verification.
Driver application: identity, contact details, vehicle and experience entered in the form.
Audience measurement: pages viewed and anonymised events, only if you accept analytics cookies.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes
paragraphs: To carry out and invoice your rides, send you confirmations and reminders (email and WhatsApp), answer your requests, process driver applications, protect the service against abuse, and improve the site through audience measurement.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used. It only sets analytics cookies after you agree. You can refuse or change your mind at any time via “Manage cookies” at the bottom of the page.
Technical cookies needed for the site to work (login session, language) are used without consent.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients
paragraphs: Your data is accessible to our team and to the driver assigned to your ride (name, phone, route). We use technical providers: hosting and site protection (Cloudflare), email and WhatsApp delivery, image storage (Cloudinary) and audience measurement (Google). We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We keep your data as long as needed for the purposes above and to meet our legal obligations (notably accounting). You can ask for its deletion at any time, subject to those obligations.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Under Senegalese law no. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on personal data protection, you have the right to access, rectify, object to and delete your data. Write to contact@navettexpress.com; we reply as soon as possible.
You may also contact Senegal's Personal Data Protection Commission (CDP).

sections.heading: 8. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.
